difficulty_design: The final ad remains concise and does not require additional visible content blocks.
Difficulty is shifted to a post-activation publication handoff with an independent cutoff and exact-match release selection.
The publication package overrides activation copy without changing the retained base-copy identity.
Asset selection requires ordered candidate evaluation, same-timestamp revision resolution, delivery-QA clearance and legal clearance.
The highest-priority candidate is deliberately near-correct but fails text-integrity and safe-zone QA; the second candidate is the first publishable pack.
Grounded VQAs remain twelve small rational checks; score 2 requires complete factual agreement.
The single visual VQA and its exact rubric remain unchanged.
